terminological-twists.name: Terminological Twists
terminological-twists.description: Flash fiction contest: short stories that riff on technical terms from protocol science and computer networking. Ongoing.

ghosts-in-machines.name: Ghosts in Machines
ghosts-in-machines.description: Summer 2025 fiction contest exploring human-AI entanglement and the phenomenology of intelligent systems. 8 stories.

the-librarians.name: The Librarians
the-librarians.description: Summer 2025 fiction series: 7 stories exploring archival memory, curation, and knowledge stewardship. Concluded with editorial postmortem.

building-and-burning-bridges.name: Building and Burning Bridges
building-and-burning-bridges.description: Winter 2026 fiction contest on bridge-building and bridge-burning as social and infrastructural metaphors. Ongoing.

zoothesia.name: Zoothesia
zoothesia.author: Spencer Nitkey
zoothesia.description: Spencer Nitkey's ongoing speculative fiction series exploring animal sensation, embodied cognition, and non-human perspectives.

bridge-atlas.name: Bridge Atlas
bridge-atlas.description: Interview series exploring protocol-adjacent practitioners at the boundaries of disciplines. Five episodes (fall 2025).

protocols-for-the-long-now.name: Protocols for the Long Now
protocols-for-the-long-now.description: Emerging series (May 2026) on long-horizon protocol design and civilizational-scale coordination.

sachin-train-series.name: The UE-T1 Train Series
sachin-train-series.author: Sachin Benny
sachin-train-series.description: Sachin Benny's linked speculative fiction stories set aboard or around the UE-T1 train network. No Substack tag yet.

sigfpt.name: Formal Protocol Theory
sigfpt.description: Special Interest Group on Formal Protocol Theory. Theoretical foundations: what protocols are, how they compose, how they fail.

sigbiz.name: Protocols for Business
sigbiz.description: Special Interest Group on business protocols: organizational structures, market coordination, strategy as protocol design.

sigmem.name: Memory Research Group
sigmem.description: Special Interest Group on memory: archival, biological, institutional, and computational protocols for preserving and accessing the past.

sigfic.name: Protocol Fiction
sigfic.description: Special Interest Group on protocol fiction: fiction as a medium for exploring protocol dynamics and governance imagination.

obliquities.name: Obliquities
obliquities.author: Venkatesh Rao
obliquities.description: Venkatesh Rao's editorial column. Oblique takes on protocol phenomena at the edges of the main research agenda.
